scripts.clean: rm -rf target && rm -rf gen && cargo clean
scripts.build: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo tauri build
scripts.dev:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && cargo tauri dev
